_comment: Required suites fail the build. Tracked suites are known-failing or need infrastructure CI does not have; they run, are reported with their reason, and never turn green silently. A tracked suite that starts passing is flagged so it can be promoted. The 'docker' group runs only in the CI job that provides Docker and a Postgres service; there a skip is a failure.

required.area: quotation persistence, payments ledger, uploads signature, session renewal, phone matching
route policy, AI draft cannot auto-save, 30 chained suites

tracked.reason: pageFingerprint() uses ids only, so a second page with the same ids but newer content is treated as a repeated page; test expects both pages. Production sync logic, left unchanged pending owner decision.
needs a built dist/server.cjs and database credentials

docker.area: Smart Quote migration applied for real: idempotent, RLS, lock timeout, rollback, restore
